FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Clear answers to your questions. Don't leave your business to chance.

item1.question: How is this different from Excel or Calendar?
item1.answer: Excel won't email you saying 'Contract ending, call now!'. Crewset automatically tracks expiration dates and notifies you in time. You stop missing renewal opportunities and protect your recurring revenue.

item2.question: How does this help me earn more money?
item2.answer: Every forgotten contract is lost revenue. Crewset ensures you contact clients at the perfect time to renew. Saving just one contract pays for the platform many times over.

item3.question: Is it hard to use? Do I need technical skills?
item3.answer: Not at all. Unlike complex CRMs, we only give you what you need. Add a client, set the date, and let us handle the rest. You can move your entire workflow to the dashboard in 5 minutes.

item4.question: Is my data and payment secure?
item4.answer: Absolutely. Payments are processed via world-class secure infrastructure. Your client and contract data is stored on encrypted servers and is accessible only by you.

item5.question: Can I cancel if I'm not satisfied?
item5.answer: Of course. No commitments, no hidden fees. You can cancel with one click from your dashboard at any time. We're here only as long as we add value to your business.
